title: Voice typing — when the mic hears nothing

steps.path: The band above the message box while the mic is on
steps.headline: While listening, the band now warns you when no sound at all is reaching the microphone.
steps.changed: After three seconds of pure silence from the mic, the green Listening band turns amber and says no sound is coming from your microphone, with what to check.
steps.measured: 3 seconds of silence before it warns
steps.notice: A muted mic is caught while you are still talking, instead of after you stop. It turns green again the moment any sound arrives.
steps.risk: Only fires on true silence. A working mic in a quiet room still sends faint hiss, so a normal pause should never trigger it.

variants.label: Before
variants.summary: Today: green Listening even when the mic sends nothing.

variants.label: After
variants.summary: Amber warning after 3 seconds of pure silence.

steps.path: The card above the mic button, after you stop
steps.headline: If the mic sent only silence, a card now says so instead of leaving the box empty.
steps.changed: Before, stopping with nothing heard just stopped the spinner and left nothing. Now this card opens.
steps.notice: Try again starts listening straight away; tapping the mic does the same.

steps.path: The card above the mic button, after you stop
steps.headline: If sound arrived but too quietly to make out words, the card says to speak closer or turn the mic up.
steps.changed: New card for a microphone that is on but turned too far down.
steps.measured: Shown when the loudest moment never reached the speech engine's own speech level
steps.notice: Points you at the microphone volume rather than leaving you guessing.
steps.risk: Someone who whispered would also see this; the advice still fits.

steps.path: The card above the mic button, after you stop
steps.headline: If the sound was loud enough but no words came out, the card says no words were heard.
steps.changed: New card for the last case. On a phone, where the phone itself listens, this is the only one shown.
steps.notice: You always get an answer when nothing lands in the box.
